report.explanation: Current telemetry does not support the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all sampled checkout flows returning HTTP 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres save_order. Metrics show zero 502s on /v1/orders and no error statuses. The deployment record only proves order version 1.0.0 with no previous version; it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is established, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Error-level logs or traces showing actual checkout failures (order logs were excluded from context)
Metrics or traces with non-2xx statuses on /v1/checkout or /v1/orders during the incident window
Deployment history showing a version change preceding any observed error onset
Evidence of latency or saturation (pool, redis, downstream) correlated with failures
